verdict.rationale: GitHub Advanced Security bundles code scanning (CodeQL/Copilot Autofix), dependency scanning (Dependabot), and secret scanning/push protection within the platform, addressing three of the four scan types. However, no evidence of dynamic application security testing (DAST) is present, and the evidence is mostly marketing copy without independent verification of consolidated workflow or unified reporting. missing for 10: dynamic security scanning (DAST) capability, independent/hands-on corroboration of unified security dashboard, evidence of a single consolidated reporting view across all four scan types.
